verdict.label: Hold off until after earnings
verdict.summary: Every near expiration spans the earnings report. Sell covered calls once earnings are out.

factors.name: Earnings
factors.note: Earnings on Oct 28 land before the Oct 30 expiry. A big earnings move can jump past any strike.

factors.name: Premium level
factors.note: Premium is rich. Options are priced for more movement than the stock has shown lately.

factors.name: Momentum
factors.note: Stock is oversold. Rebounds can be sharp, and call premium is usually lower here.

factors.name: Put/call (open interest)
factors.note: Call-heavy positioning: traders are leaning bullish.

put_verdict.label: Hold off until after earnings
put_verdict.summary: Every near expiration spans the earnings report. Sell puts once earnings are out.

put_factors.name: Earnings
put_factors.note: Earnings on Oct 28 land before the Oct 30 expiry. A bad report can gap the stock far below any strike.

put_factors.name: Premium level
put_factors.note: Premium is rich. Options are priced for more movement than the stock has shown lately.

put_factors.name: Trend
put_factors.note: Stock is sliding (-7.3% vs its 20-day average). Puts sold into a slide often get assigned, and the shares can keep falling after.

put_factors.name: Put/call (open interest)
put_factors.note: Call-heavy positioning: traders are leaning bullish.

put_factors.name: Similar past weeks
put_factors.note: 3 of the 10 past Monday → Wednesday trades most like today ended with the put assigned (20% of the closest 50, vs 17% of all trades). Past trades in the same spot were actually assigned 20% of the time (167 trades). The recommended strike is adjusted slightly.
